name: 保护罩屋内的东汉石祠本体
prompt: Create ONE museum-quality colored companion plate of the actual ancient Eastern Han Xiaotangshan Guo-family STONE shrine. Image 1 is the EXACT line drawing to color; preserve small squat two-bay form, sculpted slab roof, front posts and plinth precisely. Image 2 is the photograph of the real shrine inside its later protective hall; govern material colors from the ancient object only: weathered blue-gray and warm ash-gray limestone walls, darker aged stone roof, sparse discoloration and patina. Image 3 is only project's illustration style sample of fine contours and restrained matte mineral-color planes, not its building. Keep no later hall, signs, museum displays or flooring. Never add readable inscriptions: all historical incisions stay abstract and subdued. Preserve all contours and gaps. No shadow or scenery. Entire exterior and genuinely open gaps must be FLAT OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, without gradient, gray wash, paper texture, glow, checkerboard or transparency. Landscape composition.
material_observations: 罩屋内石祠为风化青灰石板，石屋顶较深；外罩屋红柱不入图。
